'''Mist''' is the name of one of [[Egwene al'Vere]]'s horses.

==Appearance==
Mist is a gray mare.

==Activities==
When Egwene al'Vere, [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] escape from brigands on their way to [[Tear]], they take horses to help them on their journey. Egwene chooses a gray mare and names her Mist.{{ref/book|3|39}} 

Mist carries Egwene into Tear{{ref/book|3|47}} and then to the [[Portal Stone]] to travel to the [[Aiel Waste]].{{ref/book|4|23}} 

Mist is used by Egwene to journey across the Waste; from [[Rhuidean]] to [[Cold Rocks Hold]]{{ref/book|4|48}} and later to the [[Jangai Pass]].{{ref/book|5|7}} Egwene later rides Mist into [[Cairhien]].{{ref/book|5|21}}{{ref/book|5|23}}{{ref/book|5|44}}
